IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.CurseForgeW: Confirm the sources below, then hit Compile. You can re-compile any time from the Cursed Pool tab.

Curse Forge reads your installed D&D 5e item compendiums and matches {recipeCount} curse recipes against them. The result is a Quartermaster: Cursed Items world compendium containing Ionrift-branded cursed items ready for your campaign.
No SRD content is shipped with the module. Base item stats and images come from your own system installation. Curse names, descriptions, and escalation phases are Ionrift originals.

IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.Identificat: Control how unidentified loot appears on sheets and in chat before the party examines it.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.LootGenerat: Cache value, magic rates, and consumable drops. Enhancement and named magic are configured separately.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.LootPoolIns: Select which compendiums contribute items to the loot cache generator. Checked packs are queried at generation time.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.MagicAmmoFr: How often +1/+2/+3 ammunition appears. Independent of Magic Frequency.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.MagicFreque: Mastercraft slot draw weight for generic +N weapons and enhancement gear. Does not affect armour drops or named magic.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.NamedMagicF: Scales how often one named magical item appears per cache. Baseline: T2 10%, T3 20%, T4 35%. 0 = off. 1 = standard. 2 = double.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.ObscureCons: Potions and oils use generic names until identified. Off shows true names for common items like Potions of Healing.

IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.CONFIG.ScrollForge: Select spell compendiums Scroll Forge may read. Third-party packs stay off until you enable them. The "Quartermaster: Spell Scrolls" world compendium is rebuilt after you save. Duplicate spell names across compendiums are resolved by first-seen priority (higher in the list wins).
Scroll Forge spell sources saved. Compiling scrolls.
Choose which spell sources to include below, then hit Save and compile. You can revisit this any time from the Quartermaster ledger.
Scroll Forge reads your installed spell compendiums and compiles them into a unified Spell Scrolls collection — ready to drop into loot caches or the Quartermaster progression grid.

When the same spell appears in multiple compendiums (e.g. 2014 and 2024 versions of Counterspell), Scroll Forge keeps the first version it finds and skips duplicates. Compendiums higher in the list take priority.

IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.genericAr: Tier caps and pick weights for generic +N body armor and shields in mastercraft caches.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.gmOnlyIde: When enabled, players cannot use the identification toggle on item sheets. Only the GM can identify masked loot via the sheet wand, Quartermaster tools, or linked rest activities.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.healingPo: Scales consumable slots, healing chance on those slots, and extra healing lines per cache. 0 is scarce. 1.0 is moderate. 4.0 adds several healing potions per cache when the loot pool includes them. Enable dnd5e.items (or recompile Forge) so healing rows exist.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.identific: Obscure loot names and sheet details until the party examines them.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.identifyT: Logs GM wand clicks and identification routing to the browser console (F12). Prefix: [QM Identify].
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.lootEcono: Scales the value of generated caches. Below 1.0 for scarce, gritty games. Above 1.0 for high-fantasy treasure runs.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.lootGener: Loot abundance, magic frequency, ammunition, healing potions, and coin distribution.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.lootPoolS: JSON array of compendium IDs to draw loot from. Managed via the config button below.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.magicAmmo: Scales how often magical ammunition (+1/+2/+3) appears in caches. 0 disables magical ammo entirely. 1.0 follows the tier-appropriate curve. 2.0 is generous. Independent of Magic Frequency.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.magicFreq: Scales the likelihood of drawing magical items (Uncommon+) from loot caches. 0.0 (No Magic) to 1.0 (Standard) to 2.0 (High Fantasy).
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.milestone: Adjusts the Signature Ledger milestone grid to match your campaign's level range. Each profile spreads 6 milestones across the selected band.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.obscureCo: When enabled, potions, oils, and other consumables are presented with generic names (e.g. 'Sealed Vial') until identified, regardless of rarity. Disable to show true names for common items like Potions of Healing.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.obscureMa: When enabled, weapons, armor, wondrous gear, and spell foci present as mundane base items until identified. Disable to show true names, rarity, and mechanical properties on the sheet immediately.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.obscureSc: When enabled, all spell scrolls appear as 'Unidentified Scroll' until identified. By the 2024 DMG, anyone can identify a scroll via Identify or a Short Rest; this setting models the moment before the party has examined it. Disable to show spell names directly.

IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.scrollCon: How tightly the distribution clusters around the optimal level. 1 = flat spread, 5 = sharply peaked at optimal.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.scrollFlo: Lowest spell level scrolls can drop at. The distribution stretches down to this level as the party levels up. Set higher to exclude low-level scrolls from high-level caches.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.scrollOff: Offsets the party's assumed optimal scroll level to favor pulling lower or higher level scrolls.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.scrollUpp: Maximum spell levels above optimal that jitter can push. 0 = scrolls never exceed optimal. Higher values allow rare high-level scrolls.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.shelfAttu: 0 = Low (avoid attunement items), 1 = Medium (neutral), 2 = High (prefer powerful attuned items).
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.shelfCate: Per-category weight and enabled flag for the party shelf randomiser.
IONRIFT.QUARTERMASTER.SETTINGS.shelfConc: How tightly the rarity distribution peaks around Uncommon. 1 = flat spread across rarities, 5 = heavily Uncommon.
